notes.title: Update 1.5.7 - Big Update - Multiple Seasons Contract, Money Balancing...
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We are here with a bigger update today!

[h3]What Changed?[/h3]
[list]
[*]Income and expenses are balanced.
[list]
[*]Characters usually ask for lower prices.
[*]Shows generate less money each turn.
[*]Everything gains much less Fanbase from shows.
[*]Characters don't start asking for absurd amounts of money in new seasons of successful shows now.
[/list]
[*]Now you can sign multiple seasons contract with characters.
[list]
[*]When you make an offer to a character, click "Negotiate" and select how many seasons you want to sign for. This is the amount, so 'For 3 Seasons' means the contract will last for the 3 seasons the character works in the show. E.g Season 3 to Season 6.
[*]While making a new season, importing previous settings will automatically place the signed characters into their positions and [b]pay their negotiated salary[/b].
[*]You can view the characters you currently have a contract with at right click context menu.
[/list]
[*]List panel now has markers that show important stats while hiring characters. (Hover on Column Name to get information. Column Name e.g: 'Athletism'). You can also hide it if you wish.
[*]Characters become unavailable four times less frequently.
[*]'Looks' stat is a lot less likely to be 1 or 10 now. 
[*]You can now negotiate contract with characters who have 1 more Reputation than you. (e.g if you have 3 Reputation, you can negotiate with 4 Reputation characters.)
[*]While negotiating price with a character, max tries is now 10 instead of 3. (Includes seasonal raise tries.)
[*]On save game load, if you had a work in progress show and already hired a composer, the composer and ost quality showed as empty. This is fixed now.
[*]Right Click Context Menu font changed.
[*]A game-breaking bug that occurred after selling a universe was fixed.
[*]A game-breaking bug that occurred after terminating a contract through canceling a show was fixed.
[*]After selling a universe, the shows that belonged to the universe but were not released used to remain. This is now fixed.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the update and have a great day!

notes.title: Update 1.5.6 - CharacterCreation UI Fix, Network Bankruptcy Setting, Update Logs
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We are here with a small update.

[h3]What Changed?[/h3]

[list]
[*] You can now disable networks from going bankrupt on the Settings.
[*] The game now will notify you on the main menu when there is a new update and you can read the Update Logs in-game.
[*] Show Character Creation’s Broken UI is fixed.
[list]
[*] When there are more than 10 characters, the characters list used to be seen behind the creation panel, which is fixed now.
[*] When there are more than 12 characters, the list overflowed the panel. We now added a scroll.
[*] “Add Character” used to bring in the character without saying its role like "(1) Main Character)” and instead said “(1) Character)” unless the list was refreshed. This is fixed now.
[/list]
[/list]
Next in the plan is balancing the income and the character prices, as well as hiring characters for multiple seasons.

Thank you for playing our game and we hope you enjoy the update. Have a great day!

notes.title: Update 1.5.4
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We are here with a bug fix update.

[h3]What Changed?[/h3]

[list]
[*] “Contract loaded before the show” bug fixed.
[*] Sometimes new seasons of the show demanded you make a contract with a Network even though you already had. This is fixed now.

notes.title: Update 1.5.3 - Filtering Feature!
notes.notes:
Hello! Today we are adding filtering ability for when you are in the list panel in the game!

[h3] What changed? [/h3]
[list]
[*] If you uploaded a custom company logo, the company logo disappeared when you loaded your savegame later. This is now fixed. Sorry that it took so long!
[*] You can now filter lists according to the properties you wish. For example, you can filter the characters list for it to list only Actors with Acting and Athletism abilities above 7.
[/list]
[h3] How does the filter work? [/h3]

The list panel now has a "Filter" button left to "Close" button. Clicking on it will open the filter panel.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7JwHlBT.png[/img]

We have three filter types. Text, Option and Number.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ha2539f.png[/img]

[b]A filter has three components:[/b]
[list]
[*] Filter Key: The name of the property you are filtering for.
[*] Condition Button: You can click to pick how you want to filter.
[*] Value: You can set the value you want to filter by.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/MkbluWK.png[/img]

[b]Different filter types have different conditions that can be set (although some are common). [/b]
[list]
[*] Numbers can be filtered by mathematical symbols like ">", "<", "=" etc.
[*] Text can be filtered by "=" and "contains"
[list]
[*] "=" will filter the text that is equal to your filter value.
[*] "contains" will filter the text that contains your value.
[/list]
[*] Options can be filtered by "=" and "!="
[list]
[*] "=" will filter by the option you selected. Example: If you select "Male" for "Sex", only male characters will show up.
[*] "=" will filter by excluding the option you selected. Example: If you select "Male" for "Sex", only female characters will show up.
[/list]
[/list]
[b] If 'no filter' is the current state for a filter key, setting a value for that filter key will automatically set the condition to:[/b]
[list]
[*] ">" for Numbers.
[*] "contains" for Text.
[*] "=" for Options.
[/list]
You can automatically set a condition to "no filter" by right clicking to the condition button.

That's all for now, and we hope you enjoy the update!

notes.title: Update 1.5.2
notes.notes:
Hello! We are here with Update 1.5.2. We have bug fixes and some minor improvements in this update.

[list]
[*] Most popups are animated now.

[*] The game has music now!

[*] Cancelling a season does not automatically terminate your deal with your show’s Network now.

[*] While making a New Season, picking the same base show multiple times (or switching to New Show then to New Season again) incremented the season. This is fixed now.

[*] While making a New Season, picking base shows without making a new Show Editor duplicated the created character slots in the character creation menu. This is fixed now.

[*] When the removal animation of a button ran after a click (for example a topics button), if the player immediately clicked again, it caused a bug due to trying to play the animation again on a removed button. This is fixed now.

[*] When the player loaded a save with a show being aired, the game loaded with automatically progressing the show 1 turn. This is now fixed (only for shows made after this update.).

[*] When a network goes bankrupt, now the bankruptcy notification will show you a list of your shows you had a contract with that network.

[*] You cannot change episode count after hiring a director, a composer or casting an actor for a character anymore.
[/list]

Hope you enjoy the update and have a great day!

notes.title: Update 1.5.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We are here with our first feature update! 😊

---

[b]What's New:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Progress Bar:[/b]
We now have a progress bar! Now you don't have to hover over your WIP shows to see how much left to go before finish!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iXvY7ba.png[/img]

[*] [b]Auto Show Character Generator:[/b]
Now you can create random characters by pressing the Randomize button. It works together with your script. If you already have a script (not required for it to work) for your show, it will generate characters based on that script. For example, Sci-Fi shows are more likely to get Robot characters. (You can still edit the generated character.) 
We also changed the button layout, it is less ugly now 🥴

[img]https://i.imgur.com/caJTSW8.png[/img]

[*] [b]Information Tooltips:[/b]
We added information buttons at various parts of the game. We hope this helps making the game more clear!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/anxSHYL.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/J54HOOi.png[/img]

[*] Monthly Office Expenses changed to $80.000 from $10.000. More balance updates are on the way.
[/list]
As always, we hope you enjoy playing the game and hopefully the update will make your experience better. Let us know what you think!

notes.title: Update 1.5
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

This update fixes a game breaking bug in the save system. We are very sorry for this.

Unfortunately, this version is not compatible with the saves of the previous versions so you will have to
make a new save.

Also we changed the save location of the game. The game's user files are [b]now[/b] stored in:
\AppData\Roaming\TV Show Tycoon\

You can safely delete the [b]previous version[/b]'s user files folder here:
\AppData\Roaming\Godot\app_userdata\Tv Show Tycoon

You can also now view and terminate your contracts!

We are still working on other known issues, thank you a lot for your patience!

We hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: BugFix 1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We are here with the first bug fix patch.

[b]Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] In the reviews, sometimes player company’s name showed as its placeholder equivelant ‘{ccompany}’, which is now fixed.
[*] If the player changed the list pick panel quickly, the previous items of the panel could show up with the new ones. It’s fixed now.
[*] When a save is loaded, the directors from previous project loaded as unavailable and looked as if already working on a player project. It is now fixed.
[*] On My Contracts, the Network appeared as ‘null’. It is now fixed.
[*] Minor fixes.
[/list]
[b]Known Major Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] Contracts cannot be viewed in detail for now.
[*] A review may show up for a wrong character.
[/list]

We are still working on it and we hope you like the game, have a great day!

notes.title: Balance Patch - Minor Fixes and Improvements
notes.notes:
Hello!

[list]
[*] Black money was broken and too powerful as long as the player did not get caught. It is now balanced.
[list]
[*] It is now added by month instead of by turn.
[*] The amount of black money that can be made each month is decreased.
[*] It can only be made for a random number of months now and after a year it will stop.
[/list]
[*] The amount of money and viewers a show makes each week is balanced.
[*] The game used to direct the player back to show editor after the player tried to negotiate with a character who had a higher reputation than them. Now it directs the player back to the original offer.
[*] The characters who are working on a player show are now highlighted on the character list.
[*] The negotiation panel now has a format text that shows spinbox value in a formatted manner.
[/list]

We hope you have fun!
